entries.what: Walked to Flats High on Vinca for a regular school day. Chemistry third period with Ms. Tolentino, where Dulce decided to start the library catch-up plan and wrote the Tuesday/Thursday 3:30-5 sessions in her planner.
entries.outcome: Committed to the library homework center plan for chem before midterms.

entries.what: Lunch in room B12 with Karina and Eli, where they traded notes on the stoichiometry retest.
entries.outcome: Settled into the B12 lunch routine.

entries.what: After school she went to the library homework center for a first short session on chem and then walked home to Marisol Gardens unit 114, where she ate dinner alone because Yesenia was late.
entries.outcome: Started the library study sessions and did two practice sheets.

entries.what: Night scrolling in her room, and she made a few TikTok-style edits she did not post. Asleep close to midnight.
entries.outcome: Went to bed later than planned.

entries.what: Election day, so Yesenia stopped by the polling place at the Vinca Avenue Community Center on her way home from St. Anselm. At lunch Eli ate with his jazz band friends instead of B12, and Dulce wondered whether she had said something weird the day before.
entries.outcome: Asked the assistant if she'd said something weird; Karina said he just had band practice.

entries.what: Walked to the library homework center for her Tuesday chem session and finished stoichiometry problems fast but stalled on the lab writeup.
entries.outcome: Math done, writeup still pending.

entries.what: Home by curfew; she and Yesenia talked about the Measure K signs outside the center over dinner.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening, in bed on time.

entries.what: School day: geometry, English, and chem, where Ms. Tolentino handed back a quiz with a C+ range score.
entries.outcome: Saw the grade slip was real, folded the quiz into her bag.

entries.what: Lunch at B12 with Karina and Eli. Eli sat with them this time and shared notes.
entries.outcome: Relieved he was back at the table.

entries.what: Home after school, she did laundry planning and homework, then decided against a boba run, keeping her $6 weekly drink limit.
entries.outcome: Stuck to her boba cap.

entries.what: Thursday school day. Dulce was dreading telling her mom about the C+ and rehearsed it in her head during Spanish.
entries.outcome: Put off the conversation until after the library session.

entries.what: Library homework center Thursday session, 3:30-5, with chem work. She asked the assistant to help her tell Yesenia about the C+ but wanted it to sound like no big deal.
entries.outcome: Got a draft of what to say; planned to tell her mom that night.

entries.what: Told Yesenia about the C+ at dinner. Yesenia was strict but tender, said to keep the study sessions going.
entries.outcome: Mom agreed to the plan, no punishment.

entries.what: School day, then a short Friday shift at Taquería Colima 4-9, taking orders at the counter and counting the drawer at close.
entries.outcome: Drawer came out to the penny.

entries.what: Rafael picked her up after the 9 p.m. close and she mentioned the Spanish family-history project; the fall play at the Ortega Playhouse had Calle Ortega busy.
entries.outcome: Got home safely and agreed to interview his mom.

entries.what: Crashed into bed, skipping chat scrolling.
entries.outcome: Asleep earlier than usual.

entries.what: Saturday laundry at the card-only laundry room at Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Laundry done.

entries.what: Planned her Spanish oral history project about the stand and asked the assistant how to phrase interview questions for Tía Gladys so she would feel proud of the stand.
entries.outcome: Wrote a list of five questions.

entries.what: Helped Yesenia with groceries at Ruiz Family Market and made dinner together.
entries.outcome: Easy evening.

entries.what: Sunday 10-4 shift at Taquería Colima taking orders, lunch rush, and a free quesadilla.
entries.outcome: Busy shift with no mistakes.

entries.what: Took the 22 bus home, and then did a bit of chem review at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Finished one lab writeup paragraph.

entries.what: Karina texted after midnight asking if people were talking about her.
entries.outcome: Dulce reassured her and went to sleep late.
